title: Repair the misunderstanding before defending the sentence
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Compare meanings — Separate what was intended from what was understood.; Reconstruct the event — Identify words, assumptions, actions, and consequences.; Repair the effect — Agree who will correct the immediate problem.; Clarify the next step — State the commitment and any remaining uncertainty..
